entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I want to return something. It's a VeloBand Pulse. I bought it a couple of weeks ago, and it's just not working out for me.
I understand. I can certainly help you with a return. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with the purchase?
It's under [Customer Email Address]. And hurry up, I don't have all day.

Thank you. Let me pull that up for you... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse you purchased on [Date of Purchase]. Regarding our return policy, you have 90 days from the date of purchase to return items for a full refund.

90 days? Seriously? Because I was looking at the paperwork and thought I only had, like, 10 days or something. That's why I was calling now. The VeloBand Pulse is a great smart watch, but it isn't syncing.

Yes, absolutely. Our standard return policy is indeed 90 days. The 10 days you might be remembering is for price adjustments. Since you are within that 90 days, you're all set to return the VeloBand Pulse. Can you confirm you'd like to proceed with the return?
Yes, finally! Just get it done. I've been trying to get through to someone for ages. I want to return it.

No problem at all. I've initiated the return for you. You'll receive a prepaid shipping label at [Customer Email Address] within 24 hours. Simply pack the VeloBand Pulse securely, attach the label, and drop it off at any [Shipping Carrier] location. Once we receive the returned item, we'll process your refund. It'll reflect in your account within 7-10 business days.
Okay, that's… actually easier than I expected. Thanks.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can help you with today regarding your VeloBand Pulse or any other VeloFit products?
No, I think that's it. Thanks for your help. I appreciate it.
My pleasure. Have a great day! If you have any further questions or need assistance, please don't hesitate to contact us. Goodbye.

(Internal monologue) I should have checked the specific return window for the VeloBand Pulse. It was a mistake to automatically apply the standard 90 days. I should have consulted with a manager first.
